method.calibration: Fit each one-sided point separately using only the 19 existing supplemental synthetic flags. Point is the second-lowest reading, inclusive, to retain 18 of 19. Incumbent stays fixed. No holdout-based refitting or use of oracle noise inputs.
method.controls: Common peak-safe foreground gain, clean plus rain, train and traffic at -5 dB foreground-to-added-sound RMS. Four exact background-only excerpts per recording. Each upload is a new 16 kHz PCM16 WAV.
method.eligible: Use the existing voice result. Only primary-inconclusive or primary-unassessed clips enter the optional check. Use the incumbent speech activity gate and processed voice operating point.

probes.enhanced_inverted: An additional voice response on the exact background-reduced PCM with reversed polarity. This view preserves audible content and tests score stability. No second enhancement or speech gate.
probes.source_band: An additional voice response on the original waveform band-limited to 100–3800 Hz, using the incumbent 4th-order zero-phase filter. This test evaluation forwards the same exact samples without requiring a second speech-activity gate.

method.selection: 18 RADAR English sources per label and all available unused Llama speakers, one utterance each, preferring synthetic families with fewer speakers. Sort on SHA-256 of schema and publisher ID. Require a single label for 3–14 seconds. Crop the exact center three seconds.
